title: Evaluation of a first-coordinate slice
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube, let $b\in\{\pm1\}$, and let $x$ be an $n$-dimensional sign vector. The slice of $f$ at first coordinate $b$, evaluated at $x$, is $f(b,x)$, where $(b,x)$ denotes the vector formed by placing $b$ before the coordinates of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube
